mapper.sql: reference_route_id, visit_order, poi_id, visit_time, recommended_duration, notes, parent_poi_id, name, address, location, pcode, pname, citycode, cityname, adcode, adname, type, typecode, distance, attraction_created_at, attraction_updated_at, created_at as route_created_at
